conventions.underline: exactly one short <u>word</u> per > paragraph; never in a heading or in Scripture

footnote_tags.note: Compiler emits [^part]/[^inf]; finished manuals carry [^P]/[^I]. Pick one and apply in a single place -- regeneration currently undoes hand patches.

forbidden.interpretation: no explanation of significance, motive, or meaning
forbidden.imported_conclusions: nothing from later in the book used in an earlier passage
forbidden.invented_questions: only questions the text itself opens
forbidden.fabricated_telos: no telos without a quoted, referenced purpose clause
forbidden.workshop_labels_as_headings: Hilo de taller / Inicios H2 / Costuras de presión / Convergencia are hypotheses, never titles
